title: Ability
description: Technology-neutral definition of an ability in the GUMFALL GelFlow combat system. An ability is any discrete action a character can take that is governed by the action validation and phase simulation pipeline.

id.description: Unique identifier for this ability. Use kebab-case. Example: 'edgebearer-swift-draw'.

name.description: Human-readable display name for this ability.

class.description: The class that owns this ability. Must match a canonical class id.

specialty.description: Optional specialty within the class that unlocks or modifies this ability.

resource_cost.description: Resource expenditure required to activate this ability.

type.description: Resource pool consumed. Varies by class.

amount.description: Numeric cost or 'all' / 'variable' for special cases.

phases.description: Timing definition for the ability's four phases (design values in milliseconds). VERIFIED phase ordering: Preparation → Startup → Active → Recovery.

preparation_ms.description: Duration of the Preparation phase in milliseconds.

startup_ms.description: Duration of the Startup phase in milliseconds.

active_ms.description: Duration of the Active (hit) phase in milliseconds.

recovery_ms.description: Duration of the Recovery phase in milliseconds.

cancel_windows.description: Phases during which cancel inputs are accepted. Each window specifies the phase and permitted cancel categories.

phase.description: The phase during which the cancel is available.

categories.description: Cancel categories allowed during this phase.

damage_channels.description: Damage channels this ability affects. VERIFIED channels: Core Vitality, Regional Structure, Stability, Status Buildup.

channel.description: Which damage channel this entry affects.

type.description: VERIFIED damage type. Determines armor and ward interaction.

base_force_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the Attack Energy formula output for this channel.

body_region_targets.description: Body regions this ability preferentially or exclusively targets.

status_effects.description: Status effects this ability can apply on hit.

buildup_amount.description: Amount added to the status buildup meter per hit.

condition.description: Optional condition under which this effect applies.

targeting_mode.description: VERIFIED targeting modes: free-aim, soft-target, hard-target, body-region-lock-point.

description.description: Plain-text design description of what this ability does, including intended gameplay purpose.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions for this ability.
